title: 2026 Singapore Hot Wheels Convention

title: 2026 China Hot Wheels Convention
summary: The 2026 China Hot Wheels Convention (officially the Hot Wheels China Collectors Convention 2026) took place from 16 to 18 October 2026 in Foshan, China, coinciding with the APAxpo 2026 event. Matt Gabe was the guest of honor at the event. Collectors Conventions were previously held in China in 2023 but this was the first officially sanctioned event featuring a Code 1 car.

title: 2026 Australian Diecast Expo
summary: The 2026 Australian Diecast Expo took place from 28 to 30 November 2026 in Sydney, Australia. Jimmy Liu was the guest of honor at the event. As with previous editions of the event the event was organized by Southern Diecast.

title: 2026 Philippines Hot Wheels Convention
summary: The 2026 Philippines Hot Wheels Convention (officially the Hot Wheels Collectors Convention Philippines 2026) took place from 5 to 6 September 2026 in Manila, the Philippines. Brendon Vetuskey was the guest of honor at the event. As with previous editions of the event the event was organized by METRICS PH.
